AD: Conventional score abbreviation used in German padel/tennis; the label Vorteil explains it.
Americano: Proper name of the padel round format.
Demo: Usual German noun for an interactive demonstration.
Match: Established German sports noun, specifically the set-based format here.
Partner: Ordinary German word for the teammate.
Version %@ (%@): Version is the same German noun; placeholders retain the version/build format.
